Manifestation A: Event public hearing 2023-11-13 theme decarbonization of fuels sector and sustainable energy transition. Speaker is chair? He thanks IBP, says will give time, asks question: "O combustível do futuro introduz a ACV com base na experiência exitosa do RenovaBio, do poço à roda. Possuímos métrica para implementar o ACV do berço ao túmulo? A minha preocupação e minha indagação ficam no ar." He talks obligation to elaborate regulatory framework feasible, etc. No explicit stance favor/against a proposition? He seems supportive of regulatory framework? Asks whether we have metrics for LCA cradle-to-grave. Specific proposition? Maybe "combustível do futuro introduces ACV based on RenovaBio well-to-wheel" and asks if we have metrics for cradle-to-grave. It's a question/concern, not stance favor/against a proposition. Need determine if position determinable on any specific proposition. He says transition should be regulated, but no proposition named? Theme broad. Could be favor decarbonization/regulatory framework? But categories require same specific proposition. Manifestation B: Event public hearing 2024-04-23 theme measures to encourage use of biomethane in Brazilian energy matrix. Speaker talks about decarbonizing transport, criteria for advancing fuels: availability, energy density, technological maturity, safety, cost, local sustainability. Supports advancing biomethane? He says "tem que haver critério para que possamos avançar no tipo de combustível"; "temos que avançar mais nessa maturidade tecnológica e segurança"; "caminho que temos que seguir são esses caminhos, valendo para todos combustíveis"; discusses gas pipeline privatization, asks questions. Does he have stance on specific proposition? Maybe favor measures to encourage biometano? He seems supportive of biomethane as one possibility, but asks criteria. No specific bill/proposition? Need compare.

We need classify among categories. Need understand "proposição específica" maybe not necessarily legislative bill? It can be a specific policy/proposition (e.g., "use of biomethane", "LCA cradle-to-grave metrics", "regulatory framework for fuel of future"). Need determine if both respond to same proposition with same/opposite stance. If not same proposition => INCOMPARABLE if both have determinable positions. If one lacks determinable position => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. If unclear => RELATION_UNCERTAIN.

Let's parse instructions: "Classifique diretamente a relação entre as duas manifestações em exatamente uma destas categorias:
- STANCE_MAINTAINED: as duas manifestações respondem à mesma proposição específica com a mesma direção de stance (ambas FAVOR ou ambas AGAINST).
- STANCE_REVERSED: ... mesma proposição específica com direções opostas...
- INCOMPARABLE: as duas manifestações têm posição determinável, mas não respondem à mesma proposição específica.
- RELATION_UNCERTAIN: alguma das etapas (determinabilidade, comparabilidade ou stance) não é suficientemente clara para decidir com confiança.
- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: pelo menos uma das manifestações não apresenta posição determinável sobre nenhuma proposição específica."

But is that a specific proposition? It is broad. He also asks if we have metrics for ACV cradle-to-grave; not stance. Manifestation B: He supports advancing criteria for fuels, including biomethane, and decarbonizing transport. He also criticizes gas pipeline sale/transport pricing? He is generally favorable to biomethane and decarbonization, but no specific proposition.
